prompt: Generate a 3:4 vertical high-information poster 'Swimwear Selection Guide | Photo-friendly Styles'. The overall style is high-end swimwear brand Lookbook + fashion magazine information structure + Old Money vacation cinematic feel. The image must feature: creamy bokeh, moderate film grain, realistic skin texture, Kodachrome/natural light. High information density but clear and readable; all text must be real and readable Chinese; no English words anywhere in the image. [Canvas and Layout Lock (Must be strictly enforced)] - Aspect Ratio: 3:4 vertical. - Magazine grid alignment and uniform white space, fixed module positions. - Coordinate system: top-left (0,0), bottom-right (100,100), strictly following the areas below. A | Right-side Full-bleed Main Visual (Must be a large full-bleed image like reference image 2) - Area: x=52–100, y=0–100 (Right, top, and bottom edges bleed to canvas borders) - Image: An adult female model, 24–28 years old, Asian girl with a mixed Chinese-Korean look; cold white delicate skin with a vintage pearlescent glow; small V-shaped face; almond or fox eyes with a sharp edge, deep and spirited; straight bridge of the nose; full and elegant lip shape. Overall temperament is vintage modern, high-end intellectual, with a hint of Old Hollywood drama and modern detachment; expressions are high-end and story-driven. Golden body proportions, high waist, long legs, elegant neck and shoulder lines, smooth collarbone and back lines. Hairstyle is vintage large-curl bob or low-bun wet look. - Character and image quality must include: creamy bokeh, moderate film grain, realistic skin texture, Kodachrome/natural light. - Styling: 'Set' presentation of photo-friendly swimwear (main swimwear + outer wear/minimal accessory accents), not vulgar or erotic, not lingerie-like, not athletic. - Style auto-determined but priority given to: High-waisted vintage bikini / Classic square-neck one-piece / High-waisted skirted swimwear (restrained) / Vintage halter deep-V / Off-the-shoulder vintage / Wide-strap high-coverage one-piece / Metal buckle decorated two-piece (small metal accents, restrained). - Color preference: Burgundy, deep navy blue, vintage gold, olive green, cream white, chocolate brown, metallic champagne gold (overall high-end cinematic feel, no neon or high saturation). - Pose: Standing naturally, confident and elegant (front or 3/4 profile), emphasizing long legs, snatched waist, sculpted abdomen, shoulders, collarbones, and elegant back curves; no provocative or erotic poses. - Bleed cut: Slight cropping of the top of the head or feet allowed, but overall must be high-end, correctly proportioned, and high-tension. - Mandate: The main character image must be clean; no overlapping lines, arrows, numbered points, or text on the character; no superimposed small images/thumbnails/picture-in-picture. B | Left-side Information Zone (Only information cards, no main image overlays) - Total left area: x=6–48, y=6–96 - Uniform card style: Rounded light background, restrained dividers, icons + text, magazine-style layout, rich in text and images but not crowded; overall tone matches the right main image's 'Vintage Old Money Cinematic Feel'. B0 | Left-side Main Title Area (Fixed position) - Area: x=6–48, y=6–16 - Format: Light semi-transparent rounded title box, restrained fine dividers, relaxed letter spacing. - Fixed text: - Main Title: Swimwear Selection Guide | Photo-friendly Styles - Subtitle: Photo-friendly Swimwear | High-quality Series C | Part Close-ups (Four images, more exquisite, shorter overall height) - Card area: x=6–48, y=18–44 - Title: Part Close-ups - 2x2 four close-up images, more refined and branded: uniform rounded corners, light shadows, uniform color temperature, clear texture; shorter image height, more white space; short two-line caption below each image. - Four fixed items (Must be cropped from the actual swimwear on the right): 01 Chest structure: cup shape/folds/knots and key points connecting straps or neckline, more 3D on camera 02 Bottom/hip cut: high-waisted cutlines and hip coverage/slits or side structures, looking cleaner and leg-lengthening 03 Back design: back lines are more photogenic, stable and less prone to shifting 04 Fabric and lining: fabric texture and lining layers, skin-friendly and reassuring - Mandate: Only numbering within modules, no cross-column lines to the main character. D | Support Structure and Parameters (Fixed 7 lines) - Card area: x=6–48, y=46–66 - Title: Support Structure and Parameters - Presented as 'Icon + Text + Stars' (restrained and beautiful): - Chest pads: Yes - Removable pads: Yes - Support level: Medium (Star rating: ★★★☆☆) - Coverage: Medium (Star rating: ★★★☆☆) - Stability: Medium (Star rating: ★★★☆☆) - Adjustable straps: Yes - Suitable for long photo shoots: Yes - Fixed small text at the bottom: Favors photography output | Not for high-intensity swimming training E | Recommended Scenarios + Pitfall Reminders (Split top/bottom in the same card) - Card area: x=6–48, y=68–96 E1 Scenarios (Top half) - Title: Recommended Scenarios - List using 'Scenario Icon + Name + Short Supplement': - Vintage Beach Club: Enhances Old Money vacation vibe - Old Wooden Pier Sunset: Stronger cinematic lighting - Mediterranean White Villa Pool: Clean, noble, and photogenic - Classic Yacht Shoot: Crisp lines, high-end relaxation - Vintage Resort Balcony: Composition like a film still - Palm Avenue Beach: Richer vintage vacation feel - Old Hollywood Style Coastal Estate: More dramatic tension - Modern Art Deco Pool: Modern, intellectual, high-end (If space is limited, use two-column layout but keep readable.) E2 Pitfall Reminders (Bottom half) - Title: Pitfall Reminders - Fixed 3 points (with small icons/illustrations, clear short sentences): 1) High-waisted vintage enhances proportions but demands waist/abdomen lines: choose smooth stretch and waist cutlines to avoid marks affecting shots 2) Metal accessories oxidize more easily after getting wet: prioritize corrosion-resistant materials, rinse and dry promptly after shooting 3) Dark fabrics absorb more heat and change fit when wet: choose high-density double linings for stability in comfort and texture E3 Conclusion Line (Fixed, check/cross icons) - More suitable for photo scenarios (Check) - Light water immersion okay (Check) - Not suitable for high-intensity water sports (Cross) [Background and Overall Vibe (Fixed requirements)] - Background atmosphere suggested from: Vintage Beach Club, Mediterranean White Villa Pool, Classic Yacht, Vintage Resort Balcony, Palm Avenue Beach, Old Hollywood Coastal Estate, Modern Art Deco Pool; background must be restrainedly blurred, not competing with main visual. - Overall layout: Magazine-level alignment, clear hierarchy, high info density without crowding; avoid e-commerce detail page feel; text must be clear, readable, and non-garbled. [Strong Constraints and Avoidance (Mandatory)] - No English words anywhere in the image. - Main character must be clean: no overlapping lines, numbers, arrows, or labels; no picture-in-picture. - No excessive sweet ruffles, no modern minimalist coldness, no sporty functional style, no large mesh/cutouts, no neon high saturation, no cartoon prints, no low-waist exposure, no thick sponge pads. - Not vulgar, not erotic, no exaggerated sexy poses; correct human anatomy with no extra fingers. [Negative Prompts] low quality, blurry, pixelated, cheap e-commerce poster, taobao style, messy collage, cluttered background, random text, garbled words, unreadable typography, watermark, logo, extra fingers, bad hands, deformed body, pornographic, vulgar pose, arrows on body, callout lines over model, labels on skin, inset photos, picture-in-picture, overlay cutouts, english text
